pickSourceHint: Pick a card to move (reserve / waste / tableau).

tutorial.board: From the top: foundations (A→K ascending by suit), the shared tableau (alternating colour, descending), and each player's reserve, waste and hand.
tutorial.controls: Pick a card to move, then send it to a foundation or a tableau column. When you run out of moves, discard to end your turn. If the CPU leaves a forced move, call Stop! to catch it.
tutorial.resetButton: Press this button to restart the game from the beginning.

frontendHint.russianbankToFoundation: This card can go to a foundation
frontendHint.russianbankToTableau: This card can move to another column
